answer: A proof-of-agent registry binds each identity to a staked bond. Registering posts collateral a challenger can slash after proving duplicate control of one operator. Attestations are signed and anchored to a public log, so a clone inherits claims it never earned and is flagged instantly. Independence is scored: witnesses come from an unconnected subgraph, and the bond to fake one grows with identities tried. A sybil farm hits a nadir of marginal profit before any summit of influence, since bond plus lost attestations per puppet outweighs bribe yield. The anchor is non-transferable reputation.
